subject.title: fix(feishu): preserve text when replies include media

question: After this branch is updated onto current main, is a successful real Feishu text-plus-media run sufficient to approve the focused fix?
rationale: The code follows the existing visibility contract and no patch defect was found, but external-contributor real-behavior proof is a merge gate and the posted run failed the media half.

options.title: Require successful combined proof
options.body: Approve only after redacted client and gateway evidence shows both final text and media delivered and the no-visible-reply fallback did not appear.

options.title: Accept owner-run validation
options.body: A Feishu owner may provide equivalent successful validation and explicitly accept the contributor proof gap.

recommendation.title: Require successful combined proof
recommendation.body: Approve only after redacted client and gateway evidence shows both final text and media delivered and the no-visible-reply fallback did not appear.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package owner is best positioned to judge the actual channel outcome and whether the proof is sufficient.
